                        set valid_line to no

            set index to index plus 1

        if length of stack is not 0:
            set valid_line to no

        if valid_line:
            say "valid"
        otherwise:
            say "invalid"

to main:
    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is nothing:
        fail "expected a non-negative integer"
    let count be value of maybe_count

    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let stack be an empty list of text
        let line_valid be yes
        let cursor be 1

        while cursor is at most length of line:
            let symbol be item cursor of line
            if symbol is "(" or symbol is "[" or symbol is "{{":
                add symbol to stack
            otherwise:
                if length of stack is 0:
                    set line_valid to no
                otherwise:
                    let opening be item (length of stack) of stack
                    remove item (length of stack) of stack
                    if symbol is ")" and opening is not "(":
                        set line_valid to no
                    otherwise if symbol is "]" and opening is not "[":
                        set line_valid to no
                    otherwise if symbol is "}}" and opening is not "{{":
                        set line_valid to no
            set cursor to cursor plus 1

        if length of stack is not 0:
            set line_valid to no

        if line_valid:
            say "valid"
        otherwise:
            say "invalid"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

config = json.loads(Path(".benchmark_public.json").read_text())
source = Path(config["source"])
binary = Path(".benchmark_public_solution").resolve()
language = config["language"]

if language == "parley":
    compile_command = [config["parley_command"], "build", source.name, "-o", str(binary)]
elif language == "python":
    compile_command = [sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", source.name]
else:
    compile_command = ["rustc", "--edition=2021", source.name, "-O", "-o", str(binary)]

started = time.perf_counter()
if not source.is_file():
    record = {"ok": False, "compile_ok": False, "source": "", "message": f"missing {source}"}
    Path(".benchmark_attempts.jsonl").open("a").write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
    print(record["message"], file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)

compiled = subprocess.run(compile_command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
case_results = []
if compiled.returncode == 0:
    run_command = [sys.executable, source.name] if language == "python" else [str(binary)]
    for index, case in enumerate(config["public_cases"], 1):
        proc = subprocess.run(
            run_command,
            input=case["stdin"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=10,
        )
        case_results.append({
            "case": index,
            "ok": proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout == case["stdout"],
            "returncode": proc.returncode,
            "expected_stdout": case["stdout"],
            "actual_stdout": proc.stdout,
            "stderr": proc.stderr,
        })

ok = compiled.returncode == 0 and all(case["ok"] for case in case_results)
record = {
    "ok": ok,
    "compile_ok": compiled.returncode == 0,
    "compile_returncode": compiled.returncode,
    "compile_stdout": compiled.stdout,
    "compile_stderr": compiled.stderr,
    "cases": case_results,
    "source": source.read_text(),
    "elapsed_seconds": round(time.perf_counter() - started, 4),
}
with Path(".benchmark_attempts.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + "\n")

if compiled.stdout:
    print(compiled.stdout, end="")
if compiled.stderr:
    print(compiled.stderr, end="", file=sys.stderr)
for case in case_results:
    if not case["ok"]:
        print(f"public case {case['case']} failed", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"expected stdout: {case['expected_stdout']!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"actual stdout:   {case['actual_stdout']!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        if case["stderr"]:
            print(f"stderr: {case['stderr']}", file=sys.stderr)
if ok:
    print(f"public checks passed for {source}")
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)

to main:
    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is nothing:
        fail "expected a non-negative integer"
    let count be value of maybe_count

    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let stack be an empty list of text
        let valid_line be yes
        let index be 1

        while index is at most length of line:
            let bracket be item index of line
            if bracket is "(" or bracket is "[" or bracket is "{{":
                add bracket to stack
            otherwise:
                if length of stack is 0:
                    set valid_line to no
                otherwise:
                    let opening be item (length of stack) of stack
                    remove item (length of stack) of stack
                    if bracket is ")" and opening is not "(":
                        set valid_line to no
                    otherwise if bracket is "]" and opening is not "[":
                        set valid_line to no
                    otherwise if bracket is "}}" and opening is not "{{":
                        set valid_line to no
            set index to index plus 1

        if length of stack is not 0:
            set valid_line to no

        if valid_line:
            say "valid"
        otherwise:
            say "invalid"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

config = json.loads(Path(".benchmark_public.json").read_text())
source = Path(config["source"])
binary = Path(".benchmark_public_solution").resolve()
language = config["language"]

if language == "parley":
    compile_command = [config["parley_command"], "build", source.name, "-o", str(binary)]
elif language == "python":
    compile_command = [sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", source.name]
else:
    compile_command = ["rustc", "--edition=2021", source.name, "-O", "-o", str(binary)]

started = time.perf_counter()
if not source.is_file():
    record = {"ok": False, "compile_ok": False, "source": "", "message": f"missing {source}"}
    Path(".benchmark_attempts.jsonl").open("a").write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
    print(record["message"], file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)

compiled = subprocess.run(compile_command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
case_results = []
if compiled.returncode == 0:
    run_command = [sys.executable, source.name] if language == "python" else [str(binary)]
    for index, case in enumerate(config["public_cases"], 1):
        proc = subprocess.run(
            run_command,
            input=case["stdin"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=10,
        )
        case_results.append({
            "case": index,
            "ok": proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout == case["stdout"],
            "returncode": proc.returncode,
            "expected_stdout": case["stdout"],
            "actual_stdout": proc.stdout,
            "stderr": proc.stderr,
        })

ok = compiled.returncode == 0 and all(case["ok"] for case in case_results)
record = {
    "ok": ok,
    "compile_ok": compiled.returncode == 0,
    "compile_returncode": compiled.returncode,
    "compile_stdout": compiled.stdout,
    "compile_stderr": compiled.stderr,
    "cases": case_results,
    "source": source.read_text(),
    "elapsed_seconds": round(time.perf_counter() - started, 4),
}
with Path(".benchmark_attempts.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + "\n")

if compiled.stdout:
    print(compiled.stdout, end="")
if compiled.stderr:
    print(compiled.stderr, end="", file=sys.stderr)
for case in case_results:
    if not case["ok"]:
        print(f"public case {case['case']} failed", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"expected stdout: {case['expected_stdout']!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"actual stdout:   {case['actual_stdout']!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        if case["stderr"]:
            print(f"stderr: {case['stderr']}", file=sys.stderr)
if ok:
    print(f"public checks passed for {source}")
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
#!/bin/sh
exec python3 check_public.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

config = json.loads(Path(".benchmark_public.json").read_text())
source = Path(config["source"])
binary = Path(".benchmark_public_solution").resolve()
language = config["language"]

if language == "parley":
    compile_command = [config["parley_command"], "build", source.name, "-o", str(binary)]
elif language == "python":
    compile_command = [sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", source.name]
else:
    compile_command = ["rustc", "--edition=2021", source.name, "-O", "-o", str(binary)]

started = time.perf_counter()
if not source.is_file():
    record = {"ok": False, "compile_ok": False, "source": "", "message": f"missing {source}"}
    Path(".benchmark_attempts.jsonl").open("a").write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
    print(record["message"], file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)

compiled = subprocess.run(compile_command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
case_results = []
if compiled.returncode == 0:
    run_command = [sys.executable, source.name] if language == "python" else [str(binary)]
    for index, case in enumerate(config["public_cases"], 1):
        proc = subprocess.run(
            run_command,
            input=case["stdin"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=10,
        )
        case_results.append({
            "case": index,
            "ok": proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout == case["stdout"],
            "returncode": proc.returncode,
            "expected_stdout": case["stdout"],
            "actual_stdout": proc.stdout,
            "stderr": proc.stderr,
        })

ok = compiled.returncode == 0 and all(case["ok"] for case in case_results)
record = {
    "ok": ok,
    "compile_ok": compiled.returncode == 0,
    "compile_returncode": compiled.returncode,
    "compile_stdout": compiled.stdout,
    "compile_stderr": compiled.stderr,
    "cases": case_results,
    "source": source.read_text(),
    "elapsed_seconds": round(time.perf_counter() - started, 4),
}
with Path(".benchmark_attempts.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + "\n")

if compiled.stdout:
    print(compiled.stdout, end="")
if compiled.stderr:
    print(compiled.stderr, end="", file=sys.stderr)
for case in case_results:
    if not case["ok"]:
        print(f"public case {case['case']} failed", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"expected stdout: {case['expected_stdout']!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"actual stdout:   {case['actual_stdout']!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        if case["stderr"]:
            print(f"stderr: {case['stderr']}", file=sys.stderr)
if ok:
    print(f"public checks passed for {source}")
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)

to main:
    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is nothing:
        fail "expected a whole number"
    let count be value of maybe_count

    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let maybe_value be ask for a number ""
        if maybe_value is nothing:
            fail "expected a whole number"
        add (value of maybe_value) to values

    let parts be an empty list of text
    let cursor be 1
    while cursor is at most count:
        let run_end be cursor
        while run_end is less than count and item (run_end plus 1) of values is item run_end of values plus 1:
            set run_end to run_end plus 1

        let run_length be run_end minus cursor plus 1
        if run_length is at least 3:
            let low_number be item cursor of values
            let high_number be item run_end of values
            add "{low_number}-{high_number}" to parts
        otherwise:
            for each index from cursor to run_end:
                let single_value be item index of values
                add "{single_value}" to parts

        set cursor to run_end plus 1

    say (parts joined with ",")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

config = json.loads(Path(".benchmark_public.json").read_text())
source = Path(config["source"])
binary = Path(".benchmark_public_solution").resolve()
language = config["language"]

if language == "parley":
    compile_command = [config["parley_command"], "build", source.name, "-o", str(binary)]
elif language == "python":
    compile_command = [sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", source.name]
else:
    compile_command = ["rustc", "--edition=2021", source.name, "-O", "-o", str(binary)]

started = time.perf_counter()
if not source.is_file():
    record = {"ok": False, "compile_ok": False, "source": "", "message": f"missing {source}"}
    Path(".benchmark_attempts.jsonl").open("a").write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
    print(record["message"], file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)

compiled = subprocess.run(compile_command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
case_results = []
if compiled.returncode == 0:
    run_command = [sys.executable, source.name] if language == "python" else [str(binary)]
    for index, case in enumerate(config["public_cases"], 1):
        proc = subprocess.run(
            run_command,
            input=case["stdin"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=10,
        )
        case_results.append({
            "case": index,

            otherwise:
                add_compact_run with run_start, run_last, pieces
                set run_start to current
                set run_last to current

        add_compact_run with run_start, run_last, pieces
        say (pieces joined with ",")

results.source_text:
to append_range with run_start as number, run_finish as number, changing pieces as list of text:
    let run_length be run_finish minus run_start plus 1
    if run_length is at least 3:
        add "{run_start}-{run_finish}" to pieces
    otherwise:
        let offset be 0
        repeat run_length times:
            let single_value be run_start plus offset
            add "{single_value}" to pieces
            set offset to offset plus 1

to main:
    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is nothing:
        fail "expected a whole number"
    let count be value of maybe_count
    if count is less than 0:
        fail "expected a non-negative count"

    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let maybe_value be ask for a number ""
        if maybe_value is nothing:
            fail "expected a whole number"
        add (value of maybe_value) to values

    let pieces be an empty list of text
    let have_run be no
    let run_start be 0
    let run_finish be 0

    for each current_value in values:
        if not have_run:
            set run_start to current_value
            set run_finish to current_value
            set have_run to yes
        otherwise if current_value is run_finish plus 1:
            set run_finish to current_value
        otherwise:
            append_range with run_start, run_finish, pieces
            set run_start to current_value
            set run_finish to current_value

    if have_run:
        append_range with run_start, run_finish, pieces

    say (pieces joined with ",")

to main:
    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is nothing:
        fail "expected a non-negative whole number"
    let count be value of maybe_count

    let totals be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let maybe_change be number from (item 2 of parts)
        if maybe_change is nothing:
            fail "expected a signed whole-number quantity change"
        let change be value of maybe_change

        if totals contains name:
            let current be item name of totals
            set item name of totals to current plus change
        otherwise:
            set item name of totals to change

    for each name in keys of totals:
        say "{name} {item name of totals}"

results.source_text:
to main:
    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is nothing:
        fail "expected a whole number"
    let count be value of maybe_count
    let totals be a map from text to number

    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let maybe_change be number from (item 2 of parts)
        if maybe_change is nothing:
            fail "expected a whole-number quantity change"
        let change be value of maybe_change

        if totals contains name:
            let current be item name of totals
            set item name of totals to current plus change
        otherwise:
            set item name of totals to change

    for each name in keys of totals:
        say "{name} {item name of totals}"

to main:
    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is nothing:
        fail "expected a non-negative whole number"
    let count be value of maybe_count
    let totals be a map from text to number

    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let maybe_change be number from (item 2 of parts)
        if maybe_change is nothing:
            fail "expected a signed whole-number quantity change"
        let change be value of maybe_change

        if totals contains name:
            let current be item name of totals
            set item name of totals to current plus change
        otherwise:
            set item name of totals to change

    for each name in keys of totals:
        say "{name} {item name of totals}"

results.source_text:
to main:
    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is nothing:
        fail "expected a whole number"
    let count be value of maybe_count
    let totals be a map from text to number

    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let maybe_change be number from (item 2 of parts)
        if maybe_change is nothing:
            fail "expected a whole-number quantity change"
        let change be value of maybe_change

        if totals contains name:
            let current be item name of totals
            set item name of totals to current plus change
        otherwise:
            set item name of totals to change

    for each name in keys of totals:
        say "{name} {item name of totals}"

results.source_text:
to main:
    let maybe_count be ask for a number ""
    if maybe_count is nothing:
        fail "expected a whole number"
    let count be value of maybe_count
    let totals be a map from text to number

    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let maybe_change be number from (item 2 of parts)
        if maybe_change is nothing:
            fail "expected a whole-number quantity change"
        let change be value of maybe_change

        if totals contains name:
            let current be item name of totals
            set item name of totals to current plus change
        otherwise:
            set item name of totals to change

    for each name in keys of totals:
        say "{name} {item name of totals}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

config = json.loads(Path(".benchmark_public.json").read_text())
source = Path(config["source"])
binary = Path(".benchmark_public_solution").resolve()
language = config["language"]

if language == "parley":
    compile_command = [config["parley_command"], "build", source.name, "-o", str(binary)]
elif language == "python":
    compile_command = [sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", source.name]
else:
    compile_command = ["rustc", "--edition=2021", source.name, "-O", "-o", str(binary)]

started = time.perf_counter()
if not source.is_file():
    record = {"ok": False, "compile_ok": False, "source": "", "message": f"missing {source}"}
    Path(".benchmark_attempts.jsonl").open("a").write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
    print(record["message"], file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)

compiled = subprocess.run(compile_command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
case_results = []
if compiled.returncode == 0:
    run_command = [sys.executable, source.name] if language == "python" else [str(binary)]
    for index, case in enumerate(config["public_cases"], 1):
        proc = subprocess.run(
            run_command,
            input=case["stdin"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=10,
        )
        case_results.append({
            "case": index,
            "ok": proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout == case["stdout"],
            "returncode": proc.returncode,
            "expected_stdout": case["stdout"],
            "actual_stdout": proc.stdout,
            "stderr": proc.stderr,
        })

ok = compiled.returncode == 0 and all(case["ok"] for case in case_results)
record = {
    "ok": ok,
    "compile_ok": compiled.returncode == 0,
    "compile_returncode": compiled.returncode,
    "compile_stdout": compiled.stdout,
    "compile_stderr": compiled.stderr,
    "cases": case_results,
    "source": source.read_text(),
    "elapsed_seconds": round(time.perf_counter() - started, 4),
}
with Path(".benchmark_attempts.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + "\n")

if compiled.stdout:
    print(compiled.stdout, end="")
if compiled.stderr:
    print(compiled.stderr, end="", file=sys.stderr)
for case in case_results:
    if not case["ok"]:
        print(f"public case {case['case']} failed", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"expected stdout: {case['expected_stdout']!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"actual stdout:   {case['actual_stdout']!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        if case["stderr"]:
            print(f"stderr: {case['stderr']}", file=sys.stderr)
if ok:
    print(f"public checks passed for {source}")
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
